name: malignant germ cell tumor of ovary
description: Malignant germ cell tumor of ovary is a rare ovarian cancer arising from germ cells in the ovary, frequently unilateral at diagnosis which characteristically presents during adolescence with pelvic mass, fever, vaginal bleeding and acute abdomen.
